protocol: Settled process-tree snapshots, three trials per ordinary workload; twenty balanced fresh/warm startup pairs per platform; OS caches retained. No outlier exclusions.
limitations: No installed macOS app or live profile was measured or modified.
Hosted macOS VM has 7 GiB RAM; Windows VMs about16 GiB. No physical 8 GiB laptop test.
No OS-cache purge, physical typing/display measurement, VRAM utilization, continuous peak tracing or four-hour soak.
Reported CPU is short-window fraction of a logical core, not whole-system usage. Zero Windows samples are quantized, not proof of zero activity.
Normal benchmark app exits are verified; independent full-tree cleanup uses native lifecycle and shutdown fixtures.
No source-level RAM optimization is established by small differences with overlapping ranges.
